This Appeal, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
 The Court Delivered The Following:
 -2-
 Nc: 2023:Khc-D:10604
 Mfa No. 101551 of 2018
 Judgment

The appeal is filed by the NWKRTC against the Judgment and Award dated 29.01.2018 passed in MVC No.2906/2016 by the Senior Civil Judge & Addl. MACT, Ramdurg, praying to reduce the quantum of compensation.

entities.text: Senior Civil Judge & Addl. MACT, Ramdurg
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of accident and claimant sustaining injuries are not in dispute.

3. Heard the learned counsel from both sides and perused the records.
4.

In the present case, the claimant has suffered injuries and the Tribunal has awarded a compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- under various heads along with interest at the rate of 9% p.a., from the date of petition till realization.

Upon considering the nature of injuries sustained by claimant,
i.e., compression fracture of TIL and L1 vertebra, the compensation amount awarded under each heads are found to be just and proper.
Therefore, NC: 2023:KHC-D:10604 the assessment made by the Tribunal for granting compensation need not be interfered with.

5. The Tribunal has awarded interest at the rate of 9% p.a., and the same is scaled down to 6% p.a.
6.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal filed by the KSRTC is allowed in part so far as rate of interest is concerned.
ii) Interest awarded at the rate of 9% p.a., is scaled down to 6% p.a.
iii) The Judgment and Award dated 29.01.2018 passed in MVC No.2906/2016 by the Senior Civil Judge & Addl. MACT, Ramdurg, is modified to the above extent.
iv) Amount in deposit, if any, be transmitted to the Tribunal.
 v) No order as to costs.
